name: As Rigerd
source:
Art is our hero, who although coming from the lower class, has always dreamed of becoming a knight. Having lost both parents, Art lives alone with his little sister, Rufeena. He is very gentle and really takes care of her.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20031206133506fw_/http://www.gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/new/2001/0126_card_of_distiny/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
